contexts.text: The spiritual things of faith were celebrated by means of the harp and psaltery... Illustrated.
Holy spiritual things are called vessels of psalteries (). ( = scientific truths from a spiritual stock. AC 9394:6.)
The harp and other stringed instruments (including the psaltery) = spiritual things.
The harp with the psaltery () is a spiritual expression.
Spiritual goods and truths correspond to psalteries and harps. The correspondences were with their sounds.
A psaltery of ten strings () = spiritual good corresponding...
As by a psaltery is signified spiritual good or the good of truth; and by a harp, spiritual truth of good... AE 323:6.
Confess ye in the harp, and sing praise in the psaltery, is said of those who are in spiritual love...
